The harbour authority's lien notice on the ship.

## The Text

```text
PORT OF HALVARD  ///  HARBOUR AUTHORITY
NOTICE OF LIEN AND DETENTION
──────────────────────────────────────────
1. THE VESSEL
VESSEL ....... The Gull, coastal trader, 40 tons
MASTER ....... Unknown at time of notice
BERTH ........ Outer mole, number 6

2. THE DEBT
DUES ......... Eleven weeks of berthing, unpaid
PILOTAGE ..... Two harbour tows, unpaid
SUM .......... 214 marks and costs

  The vessel may not sail, load or discharge
  until the sum is paid in full at the Harbour
  Office, Customs Row, between eight and noon.

3. RELEASE
  On payment the master will be given a clean
  bill and the chain removed from the bow.
  Any attempt to sail before payment forfeits
  the vessel and her cargo to the Authority.

                      — H. MARSH, Harbourmaster
──────────────────────────────────────────
Posted under the Harbour Act. Defacing this
notice is an offence.
```
